idaṁ so brāhmaṇo “pubbe bhikkhū ‘cattāro paccaye uppādessāmā’ti maññe evamakaṁsu, idāni paccayānaṁ uppannabhāvaṁ ñatvā soppena ceva pamādena ca vītināmentī”ti laddhiyā evamāha.
atha evaṁ tasmiṁ paribbājake bhāsamāne araññavāsino pañcasatā bhikkhū “asukaṭṭhānaṁ nāma Satthā piṇḍāya carituṁ gato”ti ajānantā bhikkhācāravelāyaṁ Rājagahaṁ piṇḍāya pavisiṁsu.
Sukhumālo3 kira uttaro nāma jānapadamanusso lohapāsādavihāre4 vasati.

rows.l: Evaṁ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu devappatto hotī
rows.g: evaṁ rūpāvacaracatutthajjhāne ṭhatvā cittaṁ vivaṭṭetva arahattaṁ patto devappatto nāma hoti, catūsu brahmavihāresu ṭhatvā cittaṁ vivaṭṭetvā arahattaṁ patto brahmappatto nāma, catūsu arūpajjhānesu ṭhatvā cittaṁ vivaṭṭetvā arahattaṁ patto āneyyañjappatto nāma.
bhikkhanadhammatāya bhikkhūti attho.
āraddhaṁ.
bhikkhu tuyhaṁ dhammo bhāsituṁ upaṭṭhātu, ñāṇamukhaṁ āgacchatu, yathāsutaṁ yathāpariyattaṁ dhammaṁ bhaṇāhīti attho.
“bhikkhu tava imāni paṁsukūlāni manāpāni attano ruciyā khantiyā gahitānī”ti pucchati.
bhikkhave imasmiṁ sāsane bhikkhu.

evaṁ kho bhikkhu uggahaparipucchāvasena ceva dhammavavatthānavasena ca paṭisevitabbādīni suppaṭividdhāni supaccakkhāni katvā paṭisevanto adhivāsento parivajjento vinodento ca bhikkhu nissayasampanno nāma hotīti.

Satthā tassa bhikkhuno vacanaṁ sutvā “na taṁ bhikkhu Sāriputto paharīti vutte ‘bhante tumhe attano aggasāvakasseva pakkhaṁ vahatha, na mayhan’ti mayi manopadosaṁ katvā apāye nibbatteyyā”ti ñatvā “Sāriputtaṁ pakkosāpetvā imamatthaṁ pucchissāmī”ti ekaṁ bhikkhuṁ āmantetvā evamāha.
evaṁ therena navahi kāraṇehi sīhanāde nadite atha so bhikkhu.
esā bhikkhu ariyassa vinaye Buddhassa Bhagavato sāsane vuḍḍhi nāma.
jānantopi Satthā kathāsamuṭṭhāpanatthaṁ pucchati.
bhikkhu tesu paccayesu pamāṇaṁ na jānāti.

rows.l: Evaṁ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu chaḷaṅgasamannāgato hotī
rows.g: chaḷaṅgupekkhāya samannāgato hoti.
